document.abstract: The purpose of this specification is to define the necessary structures for the integration of VC-1 coded bitstreams in a file format that is compliant with the ISO Base Media File Format. Examples of file formats that are derived from the ISO Base Media File Format include the MP4 file format and the 3GPP file format.
